description: Part des énergies renouvelables dans la consommation d'énergie is a dataset listed in Data Toulouse Metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by ORCEO. Ce jeu de données présente la part des énergies renouvelables (en pourcentage %) dans la consommation d'énergie finale sur le périmètre de Toulouse Métropole. Plus d'informations sur les données: Note méthodologique du bilan énergie - GES à l'échelle infrarégionale - édition 2024 (ORCEO). Coverage: Toulouse Métropole. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are énergie, renouvelable, consommation, climat, plan, orceo. The portal shows 11 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-02-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-toulouse-metropole-fr-portal.
